subject.title: Feature request: first-class .env / environment-backed secret config UX

question: Which SecretRef source metadata may Control UI disclose and edit for env-backed secrets without leaking unsafe operator environment details?
rationale: The implementation layer is identifiable, but choosing whether to show env variable names, provider aliases, and resolution state is a product/security boundary that automation should not decide.

options.title: Approve source-aware SecretInput UX
options.body: Expose a maintainer-approved subset of source metadata with masked values, explicit edit modes, and tests against SecretRef redaction/restore and secrets CLI behavior.

options.title: Keep SecretRefs read-only in Control UI
options.body: Leave structured SecretRefs as a safe read-only form value and steer source changes through Raw mode or CLI until a broader secrets UX is designed.

options.title: Document CLI-first workflow only
options.body: Improve docs around `openclaw secrets` and environment sources without adding new Control UI source editing yet.

recommendation.title: Approve source-aware SecretInput UX
recommendation.body: Expose a maintainer-approved subset of source metadata with masked values, explicit edit modes, and tests against SecretRef redaction/restore and secrets CLI behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a product/security disclosure choice, and this account has adjacent Control UI/config history plus prior issue routing signals.
